notes: SHIP v1.14.452 - FORGE PARITY P2: THE FOCUSED AISLE RACK IS THE CANONICAL RACK. WHAT CHANGED. The aisle drew a box with a baked WebP PHOTOGRAPH of a rack face on it - no per-device geometry at all - which is why every parity line failed for one reason. The focused slot now builds the real thing through rackGeometry_build, the SAME module-scope builder the rack detail calls, on the SAME Master-derived slots. No second renderer and no second representation. Measured: the focused slot goes from 6 meshes to 57 on a cable-only cab and to a full cabinet plus one tray per component on a populated one, while unfocused slots stay at 6. THE TWO RENDERERS ARE AUTHORED IN DIFFERENT UNIT SYSTEMS, which is the trick this stage turns on. The aisle slot envelope is RW 1.8 / RH 3.8 / RD 1.2 on a 2.35 pitch; the canonical rack is RW 6.0 / RD 9.0 with RH = totalU * 0.34, so a 48U cabinet stands 16.32 tall - over four times the aisle height. Dropping it in unscaled would bury the neighbouring racks. It is UNIFORMLY scaled to the aisle rack height: uniform because a non-uniform fit to the 1.8x3.8 box would distort proportions R2 deliberately corrected. The canonical rack is narrower than the old photo box as a result, and that is the correct proportion winning. A VOCABULARY FIX THIS DEPENDED ON, and it would have been a silent defect. deploy_forge_slots ALREADY normalises its slots through _TMAP, so aisle slots arrive as DISPLAY keys (gpu/switch/pdu/cdu) while the rack detail passes RAW codes (gpu/sw/pwr/cdu). The builder did a raw _TMAP lookup, which has no switch and no pdu key - so every aisle switch and every aisle power shelf would have fallen to unknown and rendered magenta. It now goes through Vocabulary.typeOf, which is IDEMPOTENT by construction and exists for exactly this. PROVABLY NEUTRAL FOR BUILD: for a raw code typeOf IS the _TMAP lookup, and an unmapped code still lands on unknown. TOTALU IS NOW CACHED PER CAB, in lockstep with the slots it belongs to and cleared by the same two paths, because a derived cache that outlives its Master is Contract 12 and a stale totalU would size a rack against the wrong cabinet. master_rackToElevation already returned it; Forge was reading it once for the geometry linter and dropping it. ONE CANONICAL RACK AT A TIME. It is built on focus and disposed on unfocus, so the plus/minus-2 window costs what it always did and moving across racks cannot accumulate geometry. Disposal frees geometry and the textures the builder minted through the registry passed in, and deliberately does NOT free the builder kind-cached materials - those are owned by the builder and freeing them would blank the next rack. VERIFIED WITH A REAL MASTER THROUGH THE PRODUCTION PARSER, not a synthetic seed: the same us-spk03 rows spec 15 runs, through phantom_parseMaster and PHANTOM_MASTER.replace. s4:099 resolves 19 components at the right RUs with the right families - a violet SWITCH at U46, nine cyan GPUs, eight gold PDUs, and the CDU at U2-5 in green labelled CDU. New spec 35, three tests: the focused slot is canonical and richer than its neighbours by more than 3x while unfocused stay photo-cheap, the shared elevation door returns no duplicate RUs and no all-unknown families, and the owner stress loop - Build to Forge, twelve chip-rail rack moves, close, Build, reopen - leaves exactly one live context, no canvas growth and under one rack of geometry. A MEASUREMENT FLAW THE STRESS TEST CAUGHT IN ITSELF, worth recording. It first reported 162 to 666 meshes and read as a leak. Nothing had leaked: the instrument records every scene it ever renders and never drops one, so after a close and reopen it was counting the DISPOSED scene alongside the live one. A leak check whose own bookkeeping accumulates cannot answer whether geometry accumulated. The registry is now cleared before each reading. RUNS (phone-webkit, each spec ALONE): 35 = 3, 31 = 4, 33 = 4, 34 = 3, 30 = 4, 20 = 6, 15-dual-source-master = 7, 32 = 3, 02-build-forge = 14 including the x10 aisle round trip, 08-forge-layout = 17 passed with 1 skipped. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, 12 style blocks brace-balanced, 0 bare LF, three-stamp lockstep at .452. STILL MIXED, AND IT LOOKS IT. Neighbours and background keep their photo tiers this stage, so a canonical focused rack sits beside photographed ones and the two read as different products. That is P3. DEVICE-VERIFY: load a Master, open the aisle, tap a rack to focus it. PASS is the focused rack showing a real cabinet - frame, rails, individual device trays in family colours - where it used to show a flat photo, with the aisle still walking and no slowdown across ten racks. FAIL is a blank focused rack, a rack that dwarfs or overlaps its neighbours, or magenta devices.
